opex.name: Sales and marketing
opex.note: Selling the platform and winning new merchants. Up 14% YoY.

opex.name: Research and development
opex.note: Building the platform and new commerce and AI features. Up 33% YoY.

opex.name: General and administrative
opex.note: The back office — finance, legal and admin. Up 13% YoY.

opex.name: Transaction and loan losses
opex.note: Losses on merchant loans and cash advances, and transaction losses. Down 19% YoY.

follow100Note: Merchant solutions brings in $77.66 of every $100 — mostly a cut of merchants' sales — but it is also the expensive part to run: direct costs eat $52.41 of every $100 overall.
footerNote: The earnings release prints a condensed statement (operating income $568M, net other expense including taxes of $106M, net income $462M); the split of that $106M into other expense, the equity-method loss and tax comes from the detailed statement in Shopify's Form 10-Q filed the same day, as the release itself directs.
oneTimers: A $127M unrealized (mark-to-market — paper) loss on equity and other investments, partly offset by a $10M realized gain, plus a $21M loss on Shopify's equity-method investment, cut $138M from pre-tax profit. Shopify says net income excluding the impact of equity investments was $584M (non-GAAP).
otherDetail: Other expense of $69M in total: $65M of interest income and a $10M realized gain on investments were outweighed by a $127M unrealized (paper) loss on equity and other investments and a $21M loss on the equity-method investment, partly offset by a $4M foreign-exchange gain. The $21M equity-method loss is the separate equityM line; the rest nets to otherIncomeM of -$48M.

segments.name: Subscription solutions
segments.note: The monthly plans merchants pay to run their stores on Shopify. Up 20% YoY.

segments.name: Merchant solutions
segments.note: Mostly payment processing (Shopify Payments) — a cut of the sales flowing through merchants' stores — plus shipping and other merchant services. Up 35% YoY and 78% of all revenue.

sources.label: Form 10-Q — detailed statements of operations (SEC EDGAR)

takeaways.text: Revenue rose 32% to $3.74B, the same growth rate as a year ago but on a much bigger base. Merchant solutions led, up 35% to $2.91B, as $119.1B of sales flowed through the platform, up 29%.
takeaways.title: Growth held at full speed

takeaways.text: Free cash flow was $816M — 22% of revenue — from $818M of operating cash flow and just $2M of capital spending (capex — money spent on property and equipment).
takeaways.title: Cash generation is the quiet story

takeaways.text: Operating income jumped 66% to $568M, but net income was $462M: a $127M paper loss on equity investments, a $21M equity-method loss and $37M of tax all came out after the operating line.
takeaways.title: Investment losses trimmed the profit

verdict: Shopify grew revenue 32% to $3.7B and kept $462M as profit — even after a $127M paper loss on its equity investments dragged on the bottom line.
